scripts.build: node build.mjs && node platform-build.mjs && node thread-runtime-build.mjs && node asset-bridge-build.mjs && node texture-upload-build.mjs && node smac-map-build.mjs && node buffer-copy-build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none --test-timeout=15000 canvas.test.mjs texture-upload.test.mjs platform.test.mjs thread-runtime.test.mjs smac-map.test.mjs buffer-copy.test.mjs
scripts.test:gameplay: node --test --test-concurrency=1 gameplay.test.mjs normal-game.test.mjs colony-production.test.mjs land-resources.test.mjs former-work.test.mjs
scripts.test:regressions: python3 ../behavior-tests/fast.py --suite base-growth-regression --suite combat-rollback-regression --suite faction-retry-regression --suite popup-sound-regression --suite popup-resize-regression
scripts.test:nutrient-rules: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="Quick Start loads the installed nutrient rule|ordinary startup consumes installed nutrient rules" gameplay.test.mjs normal-game.test.mjs
scripts.test:mineral-rules: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="Quick Start loads installed mineral|ordinary startup consumes installed mineral" gameplay.test.mjs normal-game.test.mjs
scripts.test:world-sizes: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="Quick Start loads installed world sizes|ordinary startup consumes installed world sizes" gameplay.test.mjs normal-game.test.mjs
scripts.test:dimensions: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="custom dimensions load installed text" normal-game.test.mjs
